description:
Fetch the full content of a single JobMojito documentation page.

Accepts a URL returned by `search_documentation`. For developer docs the
clean Markdown (.md) variant is fetched automatically. Only
developer.jobmojito.com and help.jobmojito.com URLs are allowed.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

max_chars.description: Truncate content to this many characters (default 20000).

name: get_documentation
title: Read a JobMojito documentation page
